thread:
maria: heads-up — olivia from sales wants a proposal for FinEdge pilot: p95=150ms, p99=350ms across mixed short/long queries. can we hit that without reserved capacity?

kevin: quick take — p95 150ms is doable on our hosted fleet for short seqs (<128), but p99 350ms is tight because of tail spikes from cold KV and long-seq kernels. need more detail on workload distribution.

olivia: customers will have ~70% short (<128 tokens), 25% mid (128-512), 5% long (>512). they care more about p95 but want an upper bound on p99. sales prefers a single SLA. :pray:

raj: product ask — we want a customer-facing SLA that’s simple. can we propose p95=150ms, p99=400ms as a starting point? that gives room for engineering mitigations.

maria: summary of our current perf run (today's nightly):
```
workload: synthetic mix (70/25/5)
p95: 146ms
p99: 422ms
notes: p99 spikes correlate with seq>512 requests and KV cold misses
```

maria: main root causes: (1) kernel choice falls back to tiled kernel at long seqs, (2) microbatching causes head-of-line when small-batch mix interacts with big requests, (3) KV cache miss/warmup on bursty tenants.

kevin: suggestion list:
- enable KV pre-warm for the pilot (cheap warmup during canary)
- tune microbatch_size per-policy (e.g., 4 for short, 12 for mixed)
- prefer fused_attn_v2 for seq<=512 and fused_attn_tiling for >512

diego: adding perf numbers after switching kernel strategy and enabling kv_warmup: 
```
config: microbatch=8, kv_warmup=true, kernel_hint=fused_attn_v2
result: p95=152ms, p99=310ms
observed: fewer 500ms+ spikes but slight p95 regressions under heavy qps due to batching effects
```

kevin: interesting — p99 improved a lot by warming KV and kernel hints, p95 ticked up to 152ms in that run though. likely because batching increased latency for short requests.

raj: product tradeoff question — is p95=150ms hard SLO and p99=350ms aspirational, or do we want to commit to p99=350ms? sales will push for lower p99.

olivia: customer says they need p95~150ms and expect p99 <=400ms. they will accept 400ms if we provide a clear plan and fallback (e.g., degrade to smaller model or reserved lanes).

maria: engineering options w/ pros/cons:
- Option A: Promise p95=150ms, p99=400ms on hosted with KV pre-warm + kernel hints; require a per-tenant warmup window and request pinning. (cost: slight increase in token compute)
- Option B: Guarantee p95 & p99 tighter by recommending Dedicated (reserved capacity) for the pilot; needs a monthly commit. (cost: sales friction)
- Option C: Offer p95 SLA and a soft p99 target with automatic fallback to lower-cost model at p99 breach + quota. (cost: UX complexity)

kevin: technical mitigation details to include in the proposal:
1) microbatch per-route override: `microbatch_size: 4` for short-heavy routes, `microbatch_size: 12` for mixed routes.
2) KV pre-warm hook: run `kv_prefetch --model <id> --prefix 0..1024` during onboarding/canary.
3) kernel policy: `kernel_hint: fused_attn_v2` for seq<=512; allow runtime swap when seq distribution shifts.

maria: sample onboarding script to include in playbook:
```
# onboarding prewarm
./rw-kv-prefetch --tenant finedge --model rdx-1 --batches 10 --parallel 4
# set route override
rwctl route update finedge --microbatch 4 --kernel-hint fused_attn_v2
```

diego: small regression note — enabling kv_warmup increased memory pressure on the pod; we saw 6% OOM risk at high qps on smaller instance types. need node sizing guidance.

raj: product asks for a clear SLO proposal to present to customer tomorrow. propose we present Option A with the condition: pilot will have a 30-min warmup window and onboarding checklist; if they need stricter p99 we'll recommend Dedicated.

olivia: customer will accept that if we include a 30-day SLA review and a canary period. they'll sign pilot by EOD if we get that language. :white_check_mark:

kevin: I'll prepare perf caveats to include: show p95/p99 histograms, seq-breakdown, and the canary warmup steps. also include recommended microbatch mapping and node sizes.

maria: action items:
- kevin: produce 1-page perf appendix + histogram images (due in 4h)
- diego: verify memory/oom risk with kv_warmup across instance types and list node sizing (due 6h)
- raj: draft SLA language and onboarding warmup clause (due 8h)
- olivia: hold customer thread; push for EOD sign-off if we deliver docs

oncall-bot: deploy-canalary/finedge started by kevin at 1845000060 — status: running

maria: thanks all. if we can get the perf appendix with the new run (p99 ~310ms with kv warmup) and node sizing caveats, product can present Option A. we won't promise p99=350ms globally w/out the warmup guarantee.

kevin: will post the perf images and the final run in the thread when complete.

olivia: great — I'll block time with customer for 4pm for the SLA review.

maria: closing loop — keep replies short in this thread, we'll stitch into the pilot proposal doc after 8h. :rocket:
